# Hunter Foo Media

> Hunter Foo Media (legal name: HF Media Solution, Malaysia business registration IP0633909-U) is an AI agency in Kuala Lumpur for businesses in Malaysia and Singapore, working as forward deployed engineers (embedded with the client's team). Step 1: a website that Google and AI assistants can read (Basic from RM886; SEO + AEO/GEO add-on +RM1,999, RM2,885 total). Step 2: lead automation (finding leads, filling in phone and email, email follow-up, funnel filtering). Step 3: closing on WhatsApp with a WhatsApp digital employee. Not a recruitment agency. Founder: Hunter Foo.

- Website: https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/ (English) · https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/zh/ (中文) · https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/ms/ (Bahasa Melayu)

- Service area: Malaysia, Singapore (same service, delivered remotely)
- Fees: website starting prices as above; final price and all other fees confirmed by written quote after scoping
- Proof: the lead and recruitment automation runs daily for Sky Employment Pte Ltd, a licensed Singapore employment agency (22 candidates processed end-to-end, 49 candidate-to-job recommendations, internal records as of 12 October 2026); see the [case study](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/products/#case-study)
- This site as an example: llms.txt, English/中文/BM with hreflang, schema.org structured data, XML sitemap, IndexNow key
- After delivery: 2 free revisions within 30 days; account management is a separate monthly fee

## Services

- [Home](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/): the three steps (website, lead automation, close on WhatsApp), live demos, latest notes, founder
- [Products & live demos](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/products/): AI Recruitment Matching System, WhatsApp Digital Employee, Content Automation (browser demos with made-up sample data), ChatGPT Ads, website building, Sky Employment case study, FAQ
- [Services overview](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/services/): AI automation, personal branding, social media & Reels — start with the one holding you back most
- [AI Automation](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/services/ai-automation/): for small teams stuck forwarding and chasing updates; fix the most annoying handover first, no software to buy first
- [Personal Brand](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/services/personal-brand/): for solo professionals and property agents; one clear line of positioning plus content themes
- [Social Media & Reels](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/services/social-reels/): for brands and professionals who keep going quiet; topics, captions and Reels
- [ChatGPT Ads](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/products/#chatgpt-ads): new; account setup, tracking (OpenAI pixel), ad copy, campaign management and reporting for ads shown below ChatGPT answers to Free and Go users; you approve every ad, no results guaranteed
- [Website building](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/products/#website-building): new; Basic company website (Home, About, Services, Contact, WhatsApp button, mobile-friendly, optional EN/中文/BM, domain and HTTPS setup) or SEO + AEO/GEO (adds titles and meta descriptions, sitemap, Google and Bing indexing submission, page speed, Q&A/FAQ content, structured data, consistent company details, indexing check report); starting prices: Basic from RM886, SEO + AEO/GEO a +RM1,999 add-on (RM2,885 total); final price confirmed by written quote after scoping; no rankings promised
